wasUser.title: WAS user
wasUser.description: Credentials used for IBM WebSphere Application Server administrative access.The credentials defined in these values define the WebSphere Application Server primary administrative user. The user gets created if necessary and/or the password is set to the current value. - If the WAS admin credentials were changed by any other means than through the helm values, the currently active credentials need to be entered as the values for wasUser and wasPassword. - If a LDAP is used, the the WebSphere Application Server admin user is never applied automatically and LDAP has the authority over the credentials. Whenever the credentials are changed in LDAP, the values for wasUser and wasPassword need to be manually updated accordingly.

Whenever the credentials are changed in LDAP, the values for wasUser and wasPassword need to be manually updated accordingly.
